blocks.x: Yeah. How long are we supposed to do this interview?
Well, it's supposed to be two and a half hours.
Well, how much is it now, about a half hour?
No, we've done more than a half hour. We've done about an hour.
Can we do some more another day?
Or you can take time off if you want to, a half hour.
I'm telling you, I want to do it another day. Can you go another day?
Sure. I'll make time -- Take it off
What number is this thing at?
Well, just stop it. It'll be right where we leave it.
